blocks.text: Location atlas for established places, reconstructed histories, corruption states, and future environment concepts.

The linked atlas contains 106 location files drawn from the Timeline, Stories, and game-background framework. Each file includes an era-by-era mini timeline, present condition, corruption type, visual design brief, and suggested environment traits.
Authority: entries are marked Established, Expanded Reconstruction, or Proposed. Proposed settings are inspiration until accepted into canon. Conflicts and uncertain histories remain visible.

Canon guardrails: humans are absent during Era Three; ancient DBA persons are not secretly intact inside cyber-pets; save files are synchronization records rather than complete consciousnesses; ordinary repeated life already has value before player contact.
